title: HPF AI Disclosure Schema
description: JSON Schema for HPF AI Disclosure metadata. Consultation proposal, not a final v1.0 commitment. hpf_standard_version and hpf_classification are required when an HPF record is present. From 0.9.3 hpf_released_version is also required, identifying the released version the declaration covers; a record made under 0.9.2 or earlier does not carry it and remains valid under the version it names. The version field was named hpf_taxonomy_version before 0.9.2; a record using the old name is a record made under the earlier draft. hpf_descriptors is a proposed, provisional field introduced in the August 2026 revision. altered_performance applies to an assistive_ai or a generative_ai record; every other descriptor applies to generative_ai only; none applies to no_ai. Descriptor meanings are defined by the version named in hpf_standard_version, so a stable value has a stable meaning for a given version. Where no HPF declaration exists, omit the record entirely rather than writing null field values. Published by Human Provenance in Film under CC BY 4.0.

hpf_standard_version.description: The version of the HPF AI Disclosure Standard applied to this record.

hpf_released_version.description: The released version of the work that the declaration covers, as the declaration names it. A released version is a separately released editorial edition or substantive localisation of a work, identified by its picture, sound and, where relevant, embedded audience-facing text. Required from 0.9.3. HPF prescribes no identifier scheme.

hpf_classification.description: The HPF disclosure category for the released version the declaration covers. Derived from a signed producer declaration.

hpf_descriptors.description: PROPOSED and PROVISIONAL. Consultation field introduced in the August 2026 revision. Identifies the type or types of AI-generated or AI-modified content present. It never determines or changes the classification and carries no threshold. altered_performance may appear on an assistive_ai or a generative_ai record; every other value applies to generative_ai only; no descriptor applies to no_ai. Values are provisional and may change before v1.0.
